name: linkedin_profile_chromium
description: LinkedIn public profile. LinkedIn requires an authenticated session and walls most data behind login — pass session_id via request_override and expect self-heal/AI to carry most fields. Best-effort selectors target the public profile shell. ENGINE: Chromium (Playwright). WebGL identity follows this host — an AMD Radeon 780M claim under a Windows UA — via chromium_webgl_identity(); no fingerprint_profile, which the Chromium runner would accept and ignore. MEASURED 2026-08-27 (2 runs per engine, 4 runs in total on the one locale this preset has, research/preset_audit_dual_engine_2026_08_27.json): all four runs across both engines returned one identical payload — name, location and current_position correct, headline null on 4/4. NO SEPARATION: the engine changed nothing measurable, so neither variant is recommended over the other, and the headline gap is a preset defect to fix on both. Four runs against one profile is a thin basis for either statement. MEASURED 2026-08-28 (retest of the same twenty presets through the same harness after the five audit fixes; n=2 per locale, 92 runs, research/preset_audit_dual_engine_2026_08_28.json): 2/2 runs returned data, name 'Bill Gates' on both, headline null on both -- identical to 08-27 and identical to the Camoufox twin. Control preset: none of the five fixes touched it, and the headline null is a standing defect this retest neither closed nor worsened. SCHEMA (final review): `headline` now declares its type as [string, null], not string. It measured null on 4 of 4 runs in BOTH records, and this preset sets self_heal: true, which hands `output_schema` to the LLM as the target contract (parser_pipeline.run -> generate_selectors) -- so a schema claiming the field can never be null contradicted every observation this preset has ever produced and steered a heal against it. Same reason amazon_search's prices/ratings are nullable. This documents the measured state; the missing headline stays an open defect.
